artifact_custody.custody_rule: every local and remote byte used by the lock is bound by SHA-256; the isolated worktree commit/tree and every contract/code byte are re-verified before Confirmation opens

checkpoint_cadence.coherence: online model + EMA target + optimizer + LR state + global step + epoch + coefficient schedule state + sampler position + RNG states + config digests, atomically

common_contract.inference_rule: restore the exact locked model/EMA/reference state; no optimizer step (encoder_updates = 0)
common_contract.primary_checkpoint_rule: epoch-100 is the sole primary representation checkpoint; N4-CRN uses the final scale epoch-50 within the accepted coherent state

representation.contrastive_schedule: epochs 1-10 zero; epochs 11-30 linear ramp; epochs 31-100 full plateau (constant within epoch)
representation.epoch_sampler: lexical Fit IDs + epoch_seed SHA256("sprint18-fit-order-v1|<seed>|<epoch>|<fit_role_sha256>")[:8] -> CPU torch.randperm; drop_last=false
representation.initialization: fresh per (arm, seed); shared-module key sprint18-init-v1|<seed>|shared|<module>; arm-specific key sprint18-init-v1|<seed>|<arm>|<module>
representation.lr_schedule: epochs 1-5 linear warmup 0.1x->1.0x; epochs 6-100 cosine to 1e-5 (constant within epoch)

status_semantics.FAILED: declared execution could not complete; preserved with reasons

uncertainty.background_uncertainty_semantics: [2.5, 97.5] percentile interval of the four seed-averaged per-history stability ratios; it does not relax the per-history <=0.10 gate

uncertainty.paired_delta_semantics: point estimates only; no paired confidence interval is claimed
